releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 优化授权状态的后台恢复，长时间未打开管理器后也能更可靠地恢复已授权功能。
- 修复 Android 14 及更高版本部分系统上悬浮窗服务启动导致管理器崩溃的问题。
- 改进虚拟视频和音频的播放稳定性、网络流缓冲与切换流畅度，并新增崩溃日志查看和导出。
releaseNotes.en:
- Improved background authorization recovery so enabled features resume more reliably after the manager has not been opened for a while.
- Fixed manager crashes when starting overlay services on some Android 14 and newer system versions.
- Improved virtual video and audio playback stability, network-stream buffering, and switching smoothness, and added crash-log viewing and export.
